name: manual_49c7f5
claim: A consumer bootstrap from issuer-signed anchor state must rehash canonical event bytes, compare the supplied digest, verify the issuer key against local trust, and atomically persist issuer, key, version, digest, and floor; only an identical repeat is idempotent, while any mismatch must refuse without resetting state.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-20 E1 C2 review: signature verification of a caller-supplied digest alone did not bind the supplied event body or prevent floor rollback. The corrected contract binds all anchor inputs and makes divergent retries fail closed.

rationale: 2026-10-20 E1 C2 review: signature verification of a caller-supplied digest alone did not bind the supplied event body or prevent floor rollback. The corrected contract binds all anchor inputs and makes divergent retries fail closed.
